newsitem.title: BERMUDA: ACE in pact to acquire Ockham unit.
newsitem.headline: ACE in pact to acquire Ockham unit.

text.p: ACE Ltd and Ockham Holdings Plc said they signed a conditional memorandum of understanding for ACE to acquire Ockham Worldwide Holdings Plc, a unit of Ockham.
Ockham Worldwide, through an intermediate holding company, owns two Lloyd's of London managing agencies, the companies said in a statement accompanying the announcement.

The companies said the purchase price was not disclosed but that it would be payable in cash and notes. Ockham will retain the right to profit commission in respect of the 1994, 1995 and 1996 underwriting years of account.
Together the seven syndicates to be acquired have a total underwriting capacity in 1996 of 349 million pounds sterling, the companies said.

The acquisition is subject to the completion of due diligence, execution of definitive documentation, approval by Lloyd's, final approval by the Ockham board and approval by Ockham shareholders, as well as other customary closing conditions.
The deal is expected to be completed before December 31.
Ockham's life insurance syndicate 429 is not part of the transaction and will be retained in the Ockham Holdings Group, the companies said.
